findings.issue: set_dwell clamps against column.position.x, but in renders/ship_ui/sgr_a_gravity_1280x720.png the label 'Ross 154 · 26986.6 ly · I details' still runs into the Gravity card (x 890-907) and the card text collides with it. The U7 note and changelog claim it 'stays clear of the card column'; test_dwell does not assert non-overlap with the card rects.
findings.suggestion: Clamp against the left edge of the widest visible card (or the column's real rect when cards are expanded), and add a test_ship_ui case asserting the dwell rect does not intersect any visible card or the centre-third rules at 1280x720 in the Sgr A* state.

findings.issue: In helm_focused_1280x720.png the Commit and Cancel buttons are cut off at the panel's bottom edge (only their tops show) and the map side panel's lower part is scrolled. The U7 note says the commit row is 'reachable (window check clicks it)', which is true by click but not legible in the render.
findings.suggestion: Give the side panel the remaining height (scroll the info block, pin the commit row), or raise content_scale min below 0.62 only for height; re-capture and check the commit row is fully visible at 720p.

findings.issue: The dwell label at Sgr A* names a catalogue star as seen from Sol with a distance of 26986.6 ly while the ship hovers at the black hole; the 'Sol sky' caveat is on the gravity card but the label gives no such hint, which could mislead.
findings.suggestion: Suppress the dwell label in the gravity/BlackHoleVisit view or tag it as the Sol-sky approximation.
